appContext.summary: A fast, elegant player for your own IPTV playlists (M3U and Xtream Codes): live TV with EPG, movies and series, favorites, multiple playlists. No content included.

theme.style: Cinematic midnight-navy screening-room atmosphere with soft projector-like glows, electric cyan light accents, and occasional warm amber highlights for contrast. Smooth glossy gradients, faint lens bloom, and fine film grain give a premium home-theater feel. Backgrounds are rich but restrained, with dark calm upper regions so the headline reads clearly over every slide.

slides.label: Home
slides.prompt: Hero: your own playlist turned into a beautiful personal TV home. Deep navy, cinematic glow.
slides.backgroundPrompt: Cinematic abstract digital art of a deep midnight navy void with a wide soft horizon glow of electric cyan and royal blue rising from the lower edge, like light spilling across a dark stage, with faint volumetric light rays fanning upward. Subtle lens bloom, drifting fine dust particles, and gentle film grain add depth, while the upper 30% stays near-black navy and calm. 8K quality, ultra smooth gradients, premium feel, no text, no letters, no UI elements, no device mockups
